notes.title: Patch #7 (Final) is here!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have collected and fixed bugs for a month. We have brought the game to the ideal state. So, this is the final patch. Enjoy!

    Game doesn't freeze when player uses Alt+Tab
    Fixed bug when player couldn't chose heroes after using a rune of time
    Fixed bug when player couldn't win if killed the Chieftain before other monsters
    Fixed bug when player could crush the game if surrendered during the death clock
    Fixed bug when player could swap heroes during monsters pursuit
    Fixed spellings errors in English and Deutsch localisations

Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Patch #6 is released
notes.notes:
The Battlecruiser team are continually working on fixes and improvements even now! 

    Fixed bug when player couldn't use potions
    Fixed wrong descriptions for mithril upgrades 
    Ability Power of Peasant has been increased by 5/20 (Base/Max. Lvl) 
    AP of Witcher has been increased by 10/25
    AP of Gunman has been increased by 10/25
    AP of Amazon has been increased by 5

notes.title: Linux port + Patch #4 released
notes.notes:
We have fixed all bugs which we and our players have found. Thanks for testing.
    Linux version is now available
    Fixed bug when player could not choose heroes after using Rune of Time
    Fixed rare bug when player could receive endless "Wait your turn" message after using Rune of Time four times in a row.
    Fixed spelling errors
 
We want to be sure what Linux version works perfectly.
We are looking for some Linux players for testing. Please, send e-mail with "Guards - Linux" to euler@battlecruiser.ru for additional information!

Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Patch #1 is here!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25621583/7cd81fd9360e351b03ae75b1ea090550fd6da0df.jpg

Thanks to everyone who helped out with testing and reports for this patch! Hopefully this improves the game experience for those of you having issues. The Battlecruiser team are continually working on fixes and improvements even now! 


    Fixed bug with endless "Wait your turn" after using rune of time
    Fixed bug when you were able to swap heroes during upgrade menu
    Fixed spelling errors
    Fixed bug with continuing of the game after surrender in the upgarde menu
    Fixed bug with russian words in the ability tooltip!
    Levels 2,3,4 become harder!

 

We'll continue to keep everyone updated on all future patches!
